text: 中国财政部发行1年期债券，规模1200亿元，发行利率1.1403%，边际利率1.1704%，预期1.1300%，投标倍数3.12倍，边际倍数8.90倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 1-year bonds with a size of 120 billion yuan, an issuance rate of 1.1403%, a marginal rate of 1.1704%, an expected rate of 1.1300%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.12 times and a marginal ratio of 8.90 times.
